formulas.name: NewBusinessOnCreateFormula
UpdateUltimateAccountFormula
formulas.expression: AND (OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.AccountId} )) , ISBLANK({!$Record.AccountId}) = FALSE, ISBLANK ({!$Record.Account.Ultimate_Account__c}) = FALSE)

formulas.name: var_forecastpending
formulas.expression: if( isnew() && text({!$Record.StageName}) ='Identify' && ( text({!$Record.Owner.Team__c})='Content Subs' || text({!$Record.Owner.Team__c})='Lex PRO'), 'Forecast Pending', 'Forecast Won')

formulas.name: var_forecastvalue
formulas.expression: CASE($Record.Type, "New Business", "New Business", "Auto-Renewal", "Renewal", "Auto-Repeat Business", "Renewal", "Renewal", "Renewal", "Repeat Business", "Renewal", "Upsell", "Upsell", "Downgrade", "Downgrade", "Cancellation", "Cancellation", null)
